name: tross-linkedin-profile-api
description: A typed HTTP API for extracting structured data from a LinkedIn profile page.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:source && npm run lint:openapi
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
